sentences.en: The manufacturer of the television set is a Japanese company.
sentences.zh: 电视机的制造商是一家日本公司。

sentences.en: So from then on, manufacturers had to pay real cash.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，制造商必须支付现金。

sentences.en: Conversion to the metric system was opposed by tool manufacturers.
sentences.zh: 转换到公制系统遭到了工具制造商的反对。

senses.zh: 制造商，制造厂,厂主,经厂商
